title: POST /v2/abilities/{abilityId}/entitlement response
description: Create or restart the caller's entitlement for one ability. Idempotent per (account, ability); requireAccount. OAuth abilities start the Composio link flow: `redirectUrl` opens the provider consent page and `connectionRequestId` is echoed back to POST .../entitlement/complete after the callback. Auth-less abilities answer status active with both auth fields null. `status` is the entitlement row's resulting status: a restart keeps an active entitlement active while re-auth is in flight; every other prior state (including a cleared revocation tombstone) reads pending_auth. Errors: 400 {code: invalid_request}, 404 {code: unknown_ability} (hidden manifests included), 502 {code: auth_config_unavailable | initiate_failed}, 503 when connections are not configured. Request body: optionally {redirectUri} (a per-environment OAuth callback URL, as V1 initiate). Source of truth: src/api/v2/abilities/handlers/entitlement-post.ts.

redirectUrl.description: Provider consent URL to open; null for auth-less abilities.

connectionRequestId.description: Composio connection-request id to pass to complete; null for auth-less abilities. Not a bearer credential (ownership is re-verified server-side at complete).
